name: 개체명 일관성
description: 평가합니다 the consistency and factual 정확도 of named entities (people, places, dates) 감지하기 위해 AI hallucinations and fabricated content.
useCase: AI 생성 텍스트 감지 through inconsistent or hallucinated named entities
mechanism: 추출합니다 named entities using NER models, then checks for internal consistency (same entity referenced with conflicting attributes), temporal plausibility (dates and events alignment), and cross-referencing density. AI 생성 text is prone to 'hallucination'—generating plausible-sounding but factually incorrect entity mentions or mixing attributes 사이의 different entities.
source: Ji, Z. et al. (2023) - Survey of Hallucination in Natural Language Generation, ACM Computing Surveys
algorithm: Named Entity Recognition + Consistency Graph + Conflict Detection
parameters: NER model: transformer-based, Entity types: PER/ORG/LOC/DATE/NUM, Consistency check: pairwise attribute comparison, 임계값: 적응형 per entity type
strengths:
• AI 환각 문제를 직접 대상으로 함
• 사실적 문서에서 높은 정밀도
• 해석 가능한 오류 예시
• 뉴스 및 학술 텍스트에 효과적
limitations:
• Requires domain knowledge for fact-checking
• Creative fiction has naturally inconsistent entities
• NER model errors propagate to 분석
• Less useful for opinion or abstract text
